name: Molly's Suds All-Purpose Scrub
description: Molly's Suds Sink and All Purpose SCRUB | Gently Removes Stains, Scrubs Away Grease & Gime, Buffs out Scratches | Plant and Mineral Based | 2 Pack, Citrus Scent Non-toxic abrasive for tough kitchen stains
features: SAFER INGREDIENTS, POWERFUL CLEAN: Our sink cleaner washes away grease, grime and tough food debris while removing unpleasant odors. Baking soda gently scrubs away tough dried food and grease without scratching your sink surfaces.
GENTLE FORMULATION: A simple, easy-to-use cleaner that is gentle for your skin, your sink, and the environment. Created by a pediatric nurse & mom
CITRUS SCENT: A cheering clean of sweet lemon and herbal aroma.
ADDITIONAL USES: Our SCRUB can be used for many different purposes, including use in bathtubs, pots & pans and carpet stains
HOW TO USE: Sprinkle Sink Scrub onto your sink, tub, toilet or surface. Gently run with a sponge or brush. Rinse with water.
